```{r}
acc_immune = readRDS(input$acc_immune)
immune_with_cell_types = readRDS(input$immune_with_cell_types)
t_cells_labled = readRDS(input$t_cells_labled)
```

```{r}
new.cluster.ids2 <- c("0" ="cancer",
                      "1" = "immune",
                      "2" = "CAF",
                      "3" = "cancer",
                      "4" = "cancer",
                      "5" = "immune",
                      "6" = "CAF",
                      "7" = "cancer",
                      "8" = "CAF",
                      "9" = "immune",
                      "10" = "immune",
                      "11" = "endothelial",
                      "12" = "cancer",
                      "13" = "CAF",
                      "14" = "immune",
                      "15" = "cancer",
                      "16" = "immune",
                      "17" = "immune")              
names(new.cluster.ids2) <- levels(acc_immune$seurat_clusters)
acc_immune <- RenameIdents(acc_immune, new.cluster.ids2)
acc_immune = acc_immune %>% AddMetaData(metadata = acc_immune@active.ident,col.name = 'cell_identity')
```

```{r}
# add immune cell types to acc_immune
cell_identity = acc_immune@meta.data[, "cell_identity",drop=F]
immune_type = immune_with_cell_types@meta.data[, "immune_type",drop=F]
# merge by rownames using merge
merged_data = merge(cell_identity, immune_type, by = "row.names", all.x = TRUE) %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names") %>%
  mutate(cell_identity = if_else(condition = (cell_identity == "immune"), true = immune_type, false = cell_identity))

#rename T cells subtypes to T cells
merged_data$cell_identity = str_replace(merged_data$cell_identity, fixed("CD8+ NKT-like"), "T cells")
merged_data$cell_identity = str_replace(merged_data$cell_identity, fixed("Effector CD8+ T"), "T cells")
merged_data$cell_identity = str_replace(merged_data$cell_identity, fixed("Naive CD4+ T"), "T cells")
```

```{r}
acc_immune = acc_immune %>% AddMetaData(metadata = merged_data[,"cell_identity",drop=F],col.name = "cell_identity_with_subtypes")
```

```{r}
p = DimPlot(acc_immune,group.by = "cell_identity_with_subtypes",label = F,pt.size = 1)
p
```

```{r}
save_pdf_if_changed(p,target_path =  "./Figures/umap_with_all_cell_types.pdf",width = 12,height = 10)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
  mutate(immune_plate = if_else(condition = (origin == "acc_data"),true = "acc_old_data",false = plate))

acc_immune %<>% AddMetaData(metadata = immune_plate_df[,"immune_plate",drop=F])
DimPlot(object = acc_immune, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.3, label = F,group.by = "immune_plate",cols = rainbow(length(unique(acc_immune$immune_plate))))
```

```{r}
table(acc_immune$immune_plate)
```

```{r}
immune_plate_df = acc_immune@meta.data %>% select(seurat_clusters,immune_plate) %>% group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%dplyr::count(immune_plate)%>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(immune_plate_df, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = n, fill = immune_plate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack")+
  labs(
    title = "Immune Plate Composition per Seurat Cluster (Counts)",
    x = "Seurat Clusters",
    y = "Number of Cells",
    fill = "Immune Plate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + # רקע נקי יותר
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
```


# CAF types dotplot

```{r}
library(readxl)
caf_with_subtypes = readRDS(input$caf_with_subtypes)
caf_signatures = read_excel(path = input$caf_signatures,sheet = 3,skip = 1)

```

## UMAP
```{r}
DimPlot(object = caf_with_subtypes, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 1, label = T,group.by = "cell_identity")
```

## Violin plot of CAF subtypes scores
```{r}
score_names = paste0(names(caf_signatures),"_score")
score_names = gsub(score_names,pattern = "-",replacement = ".")
vlnplot = VlnPlot(object = caf_with_subtypes,features = score_names,group.by = "cell_identity",pt.size = 0) & # add y axis title
  labs(y = "CAF subtype score", x= "CAF subtype") & 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) # rotate x axis labels
vlnplot 
```

```{r}
save_pdf_if_changed(vlnplot,target_path =  "./Figures/vlnplot_caf_subtypes_scores.pdf",width = 12,height = 10)
```


## heatmap of CAF subtypes genes
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
caf_signatures_expression = data.frame(row.names = names(caf_signatures))

# heatmap of all caf markers 
for (signature_name in names(caf_signatures)) {
  signature_genes = caf_signatures[[signature_name]]
  signature_genes = signature_genes[signature_genes %in% rownames(caf_with_subtypes)]
  Average_expression = caf_with_subtypes@assays$RNA@data[signature_genes,] %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()  %>% as.data.frame()
  Average_expression =   merge(Average_expression, data.frame(cell_identity = caf_with_subtypes$cell_identity), by = "row.names")%>%
    column_to_rownames("Row.names") %>% group_by(cell_identity) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% column_to_rownames("cell_identity") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()%>% colMeans()
  Average_expression = Average_expression[names(Average_expression) != "Mixed"]
 caf_signatures_expression[[signature_name]] = Average_expression
}

ht = Heatmap(
  caf_signatures_expression,
    name = "Average Expression",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = T,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Average Expression")
)


```
